purpose: Source-grounded preparation for future human-reviewed personalization, not model fine-tuning

learnableAfterReview.constraint: Private only; reported conditions are not diagnoses or clinical clearance
Preserve printed sections; two pages do not establish the entire program
Missing units and dash marks cannot be completed by inference; never copy historical loads to another member
Observations and qualitative labels are not dietary targets or verified nutrient measurements
Keep original metric definitions and scale; do not convert a 1-10 source to current 1-5 readiness without an approved transformation
Blank follow-ups are not results; do not recalculate or reinterpret a source value silently

forbiddenAutomaticActions: identify a person from handwriting or signatures
set current readiness from historical notes
generalize one fat-loss case to all members
send private sources to an AI provider without separate configuration and consent
